about:
Connector Cloud relay v1 (connector-cloud-relay-design.md rev 2). TEST VALUES ONLY: K comes from docs/connector-pair.vectors.json case "first" (sample private keys); every other key, IV and id is SHA-256("khayt-relay-vectors|" + label) cut to length. Real seals use a random 12-byte IV. Encodings: hex for raw keys and IVs, standard padded base64 on the wire, base64url for fileId and the tag. Rules: K = HKDF-SHA256(X25519(mac, plugin), salt "khayt-device-v1", info deviceId). Relay keys = HKDF-SHA256(K, salt "khayt-connector-relay-v1", info label + "
" + deviceId) for up/down/wrap/tag; the LAN seal key = HKDF-SHA256(K, salt "khayt-connector-seal-v1", info deviceId) must differ from all four. Envelope = AES-256-GCM under up (plugin to Mac) or down (Mac to plugin), AAD "khayt-relay-v1|v|k|deviceId|id|seq", id and deviceId [A-Za-z0-9_-]{8,64}, seq decimal (0 for every kind but queue). Plaintext = UTF-8 JSON, one 0x00 marker, zeros to padTo (slice 67584; queue the next multiple of 16384 up to 262144; others 4096); a non-zero byte after the marker, or no marker, is bad-padding. Files: 4 MiB chunks, last padded with zeros, chunkKey = HKDF-SHA256(DK, salt utf8(fileId), info "khayt-relay-chunk-v1"), nonce = 4 zero bytes + uint64 BE index, chunk AAD "khayt-relay-v1|1|fileId|i|last(1/0)", sealed chunk = ct || 16-byte tag, chunkHashes = SHA-256 of sealed chunks; wrappedDk = base64(iv || ct || tag) of DK under wrap, AAD "khayt-relay-dk|1|fileId", wrap mode "k1". A manifest is bad when bytes > chunks*4194304 or bytes <= (chunks-1)*4194304. Slice at (stamped at announce): refused as stale when older than 14 d + 10 min, as future when more than 24 h ahead (10 min to 24 h ahead is filed with a clock warning); a refusal always sends a sealed status. Dedupe tag = base64url HMAC-SHA256(tag, "khayt-relay-dedupe-v1
" + sha256hex + "
" + intent + "
" + target + "
" + startPrint 1/0). Queue seq = max(lastSeq + 1, unix ms); the plugin refuses seq <= lastSeq. Large ciphertexts are given by ctBytes + ctSha256; regenerate them from plaintextJson, padTo and ivHex.
WARNING: Sample keys. A build that finds one of these in a real pairing must refuse it.

mustRefuse.name: other-device
mustRefuse.note: keys AND aad are derived for dev_SampleConnector0002

mustRefuse.name: id-outside-alphabet
mustRefuse.note: refused before any key is used

mustRefuse.name: slice-at-in-future
mustRefuse.note: more than 24 h ahead: refused with a sealed refused:clock status, never silently

mustRefuse.name: no-pad-marker
mustRefuse.note: the JSON fills the plaintext: no 0x00 marker byte

mustRefuse.name: last-chunk-missing
mustRefuse.note: a truncated file read as a whole one: chunk 1 opened as the last chunk fails, its AAD says last=0
